nameEn: Wholesale of construction materials, hardware, plumbing and heating equipment and supplies
description: This class includes the wholesale of construction materials and equipment for construction and repair.
includes: wholesale of wood, construction materials: lumber, plywood
wholesale of paint, varnishes and lacquers
wholesale of sanitary installation equipment: baths, washbasins, toilets
wholesale of hardware: locks, hinges, fasteners, tools
wholesale of heating equipment and supplies: boilers, radiators, pipes
wholesale of plumbing materials: pipes, fittings, valves
wholesale of roofing materials and insulation
excludes: wholesale of power-driven hand tools, see 4659
